subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is upset that the person he has known for a day is dead.
source_quote: I am so upset that the person I have known for a day is dead!

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir’s pleasant dream about what Monks dream about was interrupted.
source_quote: Zalthir, whose pleasant dream about what Monks dream about was interrupted, looks around, trying to figure out why everyone is in an uproar.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz finds mysteries to be interesting.
source_quote: But Daz, who finds mysteries to be interesting, thinks otherwise.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz thinks Buppido’s answer sounds like a non-answer.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notices that Buppido’s shortsword may have blood on it from a victim.
source_quote: He examines his equipment and notices that the shortsword may have blood on it from a victim.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz wonders if Buppido is mentally ill or just different.
source_quote: Daz stares at him, wondering if he is mentally ill or just different.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz has had enough experience with judgmental overbrighters who assume all Drow are evil to be willing to give everyone a chance.
source_quote: He has had enough experience with the judgmental overbrighters who assume all Drow are evil to be willing to give everyone a chance.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz realizes that Buppido is mad.
source_quote: But he realizes that this isn’t someone who has a different perspective; Buppido is mad.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir thinks he had never heard anyone refer to torture as motivation.
source_quote: Perhaps I should reconsider my prohibition of it.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith was taught more effective torture techniques as a member of Lolth’s guard.
source_quote: That’s an excellent torturing technique. However, I have other more effective ones that I was taught as a member of Lolth’s guard.

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar wants to tie Buppido up and try his techniques of mental sanity on him.
source_quote: No, no. I want us to tie him up. I can try my techniques of mental sanity on him as well!

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido is genuinely horrified at the idea of being tied up and subjected to Shuushar’s techniques.

subject: Buppido’s divine plan
fact: Buppido claims Yukyuk’s death was necessary for the divine plan, but the nature of the plan and its agent are unexplained.
source_quote: This was all part of the plan!

subject: Buppido’s agent of the divine plan
fact: Buppido claims an agent of the divine plan was responsible for Yukyuk’s death, but the identity of the agent is not revealed.
source_quote: It was the agent of the divine plan.
